hero_headline: Make Movie Trivia Quizzes That Go Viral Fast

example_questions.question: Which movie holds the record for the highest-grossing film of all time (not adjusted for inflation)?
In The Shawshank Redemption, what is Andy Dufresne's prison number?
Which director is known for his signature use of tracking shots, as seen in films like Children of Men and Gravity?

faq.question: What movie trivia categories work best for short-form video?
faq.answer: Box office records, actor age reveals, and 'bloopers you missed' categories outperform generic movie facts. These topics trigger curiosity gaps — viewers stay to see if they already know the answer, driving watch time and repeat views.

faq.question: Can I use movie stills in my quiz videos?
faq.answer: Using movie screenshots may trigger copyright claims on platforms like YouTube. QuizViral AI's text-based video format bypasses this issue entirely by rendering questions and answers as animated text cards with background effects rather than copyrighted media.

faq.question: How many movie quiz questions should I include per video?
faq.answer: For Shorts and Reels, 4 to 6 questions per video is ideal. This gives viewers enough content to feel engaged without being overwhelming. Each question should take 3 to 5 seconds to read, keeping the total video length under 40 seconds.
